title: T55 (Tinyana) PNC - Revach HaOlam HaZeh — Profit Without One's Own Expense
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: The revach of olam ha-zeh cannot be measured: how much a person can profit in this world without having to spend from his own resources — what they call in Yiddish 'oys-lag' (no out-of-pocket cost). Only from what the Borei yisborach has prepared in front of him, he can extend his hand and gain very much. 'Ayin lo ra'asah'.

intermediate.en: **Revach ha-olam ha-zeh ein le-sha'er** — dehaynu **mah she-ha-adam yachol le-har-vi'ach ba-olam ha-zeh ve-ein tzarich al-zeh hotza'os mi-shelo**, she-korin **'אויש לאג'** (oys-lag), **rak mi-mah she-heichin lefanav ha-Borei yisborach yachol le-harchiv yado u-le-har-vi'ach harbeh me'od.** "עַיִן לֹא רָאָתָה..." (יש' סד:ג).

scholarly.he: [T2:55] ריוח העוה"ז ללא הוצאות ("אויש לאג"). "עין לא ראתה" (יש' סד:ג; ברכות לד:). הקב"ה מכין לפני האדם, רק יש להרחיב יד.
